Mean/median performance does not eliminate tail failures: a 46.8 m late-route peak and 34.9 m endpoint error remain unresolved.

Do not substitute the lower post-hoc optimized RMSE for the online output reported above.

This is one seeded simulation on a same-survey low-pass prior and synthetic acoustic observations, not an independent survey or field trial, and route completion is not exhaustive lake-bottom coverage.
